**Policy compliance: Yes, it complies.**

The 236-day gap is entirely irrelevant for a wrong-item claim. Rule 1 (standard 30-day window) and rule 2 (90-day defective window) do not apply here — rule 5 governs and imposes no deadline whatsoever. The approval is therefore consistent with policy regardless of how much time elapsed.

input.query:
SELECT
  c.name AS customer_name,
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.order_date,
  p.name AS product_name,
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.reason,
  r.status,
  r.requested_at,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM r.requested_at - o.order_date) AS days_since_order
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE c.name = 'Charlotte Dubois'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Wireless Keyboard%'
  AND r.reason ILIKE '%wrong item%'
input.intent: Find Charlotte Dubois's refund for Wireless Keyboard citing wrong item, including the days elapsed since order.
